name: Horus
description: Horus is a self-hosted dashboard for Plex and Emby. It shows live activity from both servers in one list and records playback history for graphs: plays per day, by user, platform and hour, direct play versus transcode, and bandwidth. It only reads from the servers and never controls playback.

notes.text: Unless you set var_admin_pass, the generated admin login is saved to ~/horus.creds inside the container.
Add your Plex and Emby servers under Servers after signing in. Horus only reads from them.
